name: contract-artifact-case-binding
goal: Bind generated class audio to an active registered case, state and artifact slot

evidence: TestArtifactService accepts any syntactically valid unit/case ID and writes audio with a registered-identity claim even when the unit is absent or its state/slot differs. The owning case only tried slash-invalid identities, so unregistered but well-formed references escaped.

Strengthen the same capture/initialized case with a real registered unit and absent unit/case, wrong state, wrong evidence slot and malformed revision. Keep one declared capture case; retain exact playable bytes, transcript and authored hash assertions.
